rule: Each canonical journey needs at least one credible external reference OR an explicit GAS-establishes-benchmark finding. Reference products are evidence sources, not templates or a whitelist.

journeys.name: New User to First Meaningful Action
bestLaws: no chain/RPC vocabulary in normal flow

journeys.name: Configure Risk
journeys.gasPosition: CRUISE/BOOST/REDLINE understandable without documentation or color alone

journeys.name: Social Result to Same Game
bestLaws: social object adjacent to economic action
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes benchmark: RESULT -> CONFIG -> TRY -> EXPLICIT IGNITION

journeys.name: Join Crew
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes game-native Crew joining/ranking/reversibility benchmark

journeys.name: Buy GAS
bestLaws: financially material fee/impact facts at boundary

journeys.name: Understand Rebase
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes superior benchmark with personal before/after impact plus reserve context

journeys.name: Understand Reserve
journeys.gasPosition: meet transparency depth while preserving GAS external-only-backing semantics

journeys.name: Refresh Mid-Round
bestLaws: stale intent expires instead of executing late
recovery resumes from failed step rather than restarting
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes stronger benchmark with durable round ID, exact state restore and idempotent double-submit prevention

journeys.name: Connectivity Failure
bestLaws: prevent delayed retries from becoming duplicate actions
hide raw infrastructure detail behind financial state
journeys.gasPosition: GAS establishes explicit financial-state recovery benchmark

journeys.name: Permission Expiry
bestLaws: friction reduction only inside granted scope
journeys.gasPosition: meet_or_beat with plain-language scope and deliberate reauthorization

journeys.name: Portfolio / Unified Balance
bestLaws: current value distinct from potential payout
journeys.gasPosition: GAS additionally distinguishes spendable assets, locked wagers, marked Bracket positions, monetary reserve and game bankroll

journeys.name: Search / Discovery
journeys.gasPosition: one GAS search/discovery primitive expands from people/Crews/games to future markets

journeys.name: Notification to Action
journeys.gasPosition: direct deep-link with stale-state reconciliation; no home detour

journeys.name: Future Bracket Event to Position
journeys.gasPosition: Bracket preserves simple event/outcome comprehension while optional CLOB depth remains available

referenceAdmissionRule: Any product may replace a current reference-best if current evidence shows it solves the relevant journey better. Brand popularity alone is insufficient.
phaseGate: PASS when all J01-J18 are covered by credible reference evidence or explicit GAS-establishes-benchmark findings, with useful law, tradeoff and GAS improvement target.
